# Security Policy

## Supported Versions

Only the latest released version of Finanze receives security updates.

## Reporting a Vulnerability

If you discover a security vulnerability, please report it privately using
[GitHub Security Advisories](https://github.com/finanze/finanze/security/advisories/new)
or by emailing **contact@finanze.me**.

Please do not open a public issue for security reports.

We will acknowledge your report as soon as possible.
